text:
sam: heads up — seeing a cluster of idle reconnects from a handful of tenants starting ~13:58 UTC. Noticed correlating jump in 'idle_close' -> 'reconnect' on the streaming dashboard.

miriam: ack. any pattern in tenant id or route?

sam: looks concentrated to tenant=acme-inc, route=/v1/stream/chat. reconnects spike ~30s after last event. sample log:
```
WARN http: connection closed by client after idle 30s client_id=cli-9a1f trace=tx-7c3
INFO reconnect: client re-established websocket conn new_session=ses-0b2
```

raj: that 30s matches `proxy.idle_timeout_sec` default (30). Are we sure proxy isn't sending a FIN earlier? Could be double-counting in dashboard sampling.

kai: if proxy closes sockets we may be attributing a 'disconnect' when client is just doing long-poll idle. For billing/quotas that causes a resume path -> counts as a new session which inflates concurrent/connect metrics.

miriam: console UX question — should we surface 'idle_reconnect' as its own alert? Right now alerts fire on reconnect rate > 5% and look noisy.

sam: +1 to telemetry tag. infra-bot, can we add `idle_reconnect=true` to the resume event payload? :eyes:

infra-bot: queued: metric-tagging job scheduled. will emit `stream.resume.idle_reconnect` gauge for next deploy. :white_check_mark:

raj: operationally, quick mitigation is bumping keepalive to 90s for acme-inc canary. but routing policy: if we keep sockets longer it increases warm-pool occupancy and OOM risk on edge nodes.

kai: we could do a canary: change `proxy.idle_timeout_sec` via tenant override + add quota-metering to ignore reconnects within 10s of previous close (idempotency window). That hedges billing duplication.

miriam: agree. small feature ask for console: when showing reconnects, display the `idle_timeout_sec` that was in effect for that tenant at the time. Currently you have to jump to infra config.

sam: i'll open a tiny PR to 1) tenant override keepalive for acme-inc 2) add `idle_reconnect` telemetry tag 3) add console field for keepalive in stream pane. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/proxy/pull/8122

raj: :thumbsup: once infra-bot emits metric we can verify with a short retention query and then roll the canary.

kai: i'll own the canary rollout and dashboard annotation. will post update when done.

miriam: thanks. follow-up item: product/console team — minor UX tweak to surface keepalive in the stream timeline. tagging @jules for visibility.

sam: closing loop, will monitor metrics and add a playbook note under runbook/streaming-reconnects.
